# Ramratan Padhy

> Machine learning and agentic AI engineer, and computer science student at SRM University AP, Andhra Pradesh. Open for machine learning roles.

Ramratan Padhy works across machine learning, agentic systems, research on large
language models, and open source. Projects range from retrieval-augmented
generation systems to full machine learning pipelines with finetuned models and
custom frontends. Ramratan Padhy is an associate at [Next Tech Lab AP](https://www.nexttechlabap.in/),
a QS ReImagine awarded student society, and a part of the FOSS community.

## Projects

### OpenNote

A private, multi-model, 100% local, full-featured alternative to NotebookLM. It
supports over 10 LLM providers, including locally served Ollama models, and
features a context window along with a compaction and summarisation service.
OpenNote reads the user's own PDFs, office documents, saved web pages, and notes,
builds a local searchable library, and answers strictly from retrieved passages
with a citation pointing back to the exact source passage. If the answer is not
in the documents, it says so. It runs from a terminal interface with dedicated
modes for asking questions, searching the library, and generating study
materials, and shows a live context-window meter showing token usage and cost.

- **Tech:** Python, text user interface, agentic harness
- **Repository:** [github.com/natarmr/opennote](https://github.com/natarmr/opennote)
- **Blog post:** [blogs.ramratan.in/opennote](https://blogs.ramratan.in/opennote/)
- **Installer:** `curl -fsSL https://ramratan.in/install | bash`

### Keryx

A local signed message bus where every message carries an ed25519 signature verified by a daemon (keryxd) against the key registered for the claimed name. A wrapper holds the key and signs via a private relay socket so a prompt-injected agent cannot impersonate another identity. Features length-prefixed canonical bytes with domain separation, per-identity sequence numbers, and provenance enforcement.

- **Tech:** Rust, ed25519, IPC, agent security
- **Repository:** [github.com/natarmr/keryx](https://github.com/natarmr/keryx)
- **Blog post:** [blogs.ramratan.in/keryx](https://blogs.ramratan.in/keryx/)

### Grand Tribunal

An Ace Attorney-style turn-based AI debate game with voice input. Two specialized
Nemotron models serve as dynamic opponents and logical judges through a custom
Gradio frontend.

- **Tech:** Python, Gradio, Nemotron, VoxCPM
- **Repository:** [github.com/natarmr/TheGrandTribunal](https://github.com/natarmr/TheGrandTribunal)

### Argus

A simulated drone swarm that collectively maps arbitrary terrain using Gemma 4
31B vision served via Cerebras. Autonomous agent drones share a collective memory
that aggregates into a unified semantic map displayed on a CesiumJS 3D globe.
FastAPI serves as the backend for the simulation.

- **Tech:** Python, Gemma 4, IoT simulation, CesiumJS, FastAPI

### Independent research on BitNet-1.58b

Novel research and experimentation on BitNet-1.58b by altering its context length.
Accompanied by a published forensic analysis of how BitNet b1.58's quantization
survives its own rounding.

- **Tech:** Python, machine learning, mathematics
- **Repository:** [github.com/natarmr/bitnetexpansion](https://github.com/natarmr/bitnetexpansion)
- **Article:** [medium.com/@ramratanpadhy59](https://medium.com/@ramratanpadhy59/the-mathematics-that-make-1-58-bit-weights-work-how-bitnet-b1-58-survives-its-own-quantization-de738e6adec1)

### Portfolio site

A zero-dependency, single-file portfolio site: no JavaScript, no webfonts, and no
third-party requests. All CSS is inlined and the page is served from a static
edge cache.

- **Tech:** HTML, CSS, edge delivery optimization
- **Repository:** [github.com/natarmr](https://github.com/natarmr)
